mathematics.assertion_tested: Independent exact chi=1 roots in three external-field point-source directions and exact isolated crossing; fixed-size Plummer mass-scaling diagnostics.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: IEEE754 float64 with analytic identities and one-dimensional quadrature
mathematics.conventions: p=9/8; ell=3kpc; original KT39 a0 footings, Solar mass/external field,24 dwarf Plummer objects; A plus Hessian stress B retained. Frozen Solar convention Q2=(3/2)q a0/rM is checked separately against raw dimensional Q2.
inputs: Frozen KT39 accepted p9/8 physical results
non_claims: No new parameter fit, data selection or observational grade.
chi is not by itself a force suppression factor.
The Solar coefficient is a fixed-eta large-lambda asymptotic, not a uniform mass-zero limit.
No global stability, EFE or microscopic mechanism established.
